### Verificación

- `npm run lint` (`oxlint`): sin errores en los archivos nuevos o modificados.
- `npm run build` (`tsc -b && vite build`): compilación TypeScript y bundle de producción completados correctamente.

### Modern Web Guidance

- **`forms`**: I implemented the 4-option ringtone picker with native `<input type="radio">` inside `<fieldset>`/`<legend>`, inline labels after each input, `48px+` touch targets, `max(1rem, 1em)` font sizing, and an explicit submit action instead of a dropdown or auto-save ("Expose 2 to 5 mutually exclusive options as visible radio buttons when choices are fewer than six; use `<select>` only when space is constrained or the list is long.").
- **`accessibility`**: I kept radio options out of `<ul>`/`<li>` markup to avoid duplicate count announcements, wired explicit `htmlFor`/`id` pairs, replaced fake card headings with semantic `<h1>`/`<h2>`, added a skip link and SPA title updates, and used `role="status"` without redundant ARIA attributes ("Don't use lists for checkboxes and radio buttons").
- **`brand-consistent-forms`**: I styled the native radio buttons with high-contrast `accent-color: var(--primary)` paired with light/dark `color-scheme` and added a progressive-enhancement fallback using the visually hidden `clip-path: inset(50%)` input pattern with custom indicators so older browsers keep branded, keyboard-accessible controls ("You MUST use the `@supports not` rule to apply custom fallback styles only when `accent-color` is not supported.").
